authenticator.title: Authenticator app
authenticator.description: Set an authenticator app (TOTP) as a second verification method. Once set up, security-sensitive operations ask you to verify your identity again.
authenticator.replacingNotice: Two-step verification is already on for this account. Confirming replaces the current authenticator, and the current recovery codes stop working.
authenticator.enrollDescription: Add the content below to your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.

recoveryCodes.title: Recovery codes
recoveryCodes.description: A recovery code stands in for the 6-digit code when you cannot use your authenticator app. Regenerating discards the current set.
recoveryCodes.showOnceDescription: These codes are shown exactly once — save them now. Each code can be used once.

stepUp.title: Verify your identity
stepUp.description: This action requires you to verify your identity again. Enter a 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one recovery code.
